title: vault_meta_rewrite — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins one byte-level case for protocol::rewrite_vault_meta_password_side: re-derives password-side fields (password_wrap_key from new_password + fresh_salt + existing.account_number_hash + preserved KDF params) and produces a fresh 345-byte MYV1 blob with recovery-side + items_key fields byte-preserved from the existing input. Spec contract: docs/spec/protocol.md §9.3 + docs/spec/recovery-flow.md §4.2/§4.4. Single case_kind — no discriminator. The Rust reference implementation lives at protocol/src/vault_meta.rs (main myne repository).

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'vault_meta_rewrite/v0.1/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

input_existing_vault_meta_hex.description: Existing 345-byte MYV1 vault.meta blob (hex). The decoder reads account_number_hash, kdf_params, random_salt_recovery, nonce_recovery_wrap, enc_root_key_recovery, and the items_key block; rewrite preserves recovery + items_key bytes verbatim.

input_root_key_hex.description: 32-byte root_key (hex). The function AEAD-seals this under the freshly-derived password_wrap_key.

input_new_password_utf8_hex.description: New password (UTF-8 bytes, hex-encoded). Fed directly into Argon2id without normalization (passwords are not BIP-39 phrases; spec §3 only normalizes the recovery phrase).

input_fresh_salt_hex.description: 16-byte Argon2id salt for the new password derivation (hex). Production callers source from OS CSPRNG; vectors pin a constant.

input_fresh_nonce_hex.description: 24-byte XChaCha20-Poly1305 nonce for sealing root_key under the new password_wrap_key (hex). Production callers source from OS CSPRNG; vectors pin a constant.

m_kib.description: Argon2id memory parameter in KiB (preserved from the existing vault.meta — the rewrite does NOT change KDF params).

argon2_version_hex.description: Argon2 version byte (0x13 for v1.3 — the v0.1 baseline).

informational_kdf_params_from_existing.description: Informational — the KDF parameter block extracted from the existing vault.meta. The encoder pulls these from input_existing_vault_meta_hex; this object is not consumed by the encoder, it's carried so reviewers can verify intermediate state without re-parsing the existing meta blob.

expected_vault_meta_hex.description: Full 345-byte rewritten MYV1 blob (hex). Implementations compare byte-equal.
